title: Acid-base titration
prompt: a burette on a stand over a conical flask on a magnetic stirrer with a pH meter and indicator: add base drop by drop from the burette, swirl, watch the pH creep then jump and the indicator flip from colourless to pink at the endpoint, overshoot and go purple, reset; see-through shows hydrogen and hydroxide ions in the flask neutralising into water and a live pH-against-volume curve
blurb: Titrate 25 mL of 0.1 M hydrochloric acid with sodium hydroxide from a burette: the pH creeps, then leaps at 25 mL as phenolphthalein flips to pink, while see-through shows H+ and OH- pairing into water and the S-shaped curve drawing itself.
